# DMCC Uptown Place Twin Towers

> One Uptown Place and Two Uptown Place are twin commercial towers of 21 and 15 storeys in the Uptown Dubai district, next to Jumeirah Lakes Towers. Together they add more than 560,000 sq ft of Grade A office space and 82,000 sq ft of retail, with floor plates ranging from 2,100 to 17,600 sq ft. Amenities include in-building dining, a swimming pool and more than 1,600 parking spaces, and both towers target LEED Gold certification.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Uptown Dubai District, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2028

## MENASCO Scope

Towers T3 and T4 form part of Phase 2 of Uptown Dubai District, DMCC's landmark mixed-use destination beside Jumeirah Lakes Towers. MENASCO was entrusted with the full MEP scope, covering the engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, with integrated building automation designed to support the district's commercial, retail and hospitality functions efficiently.
